mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 63 degrees with moderate rain by Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in its Waning Gibbous phase, and you can expect that temperature to hold at 63 degrees overnight with rain continuing in the forecast.

The city has two important updates for you. First, the Records Section of the Police Department now uses crashdocs.org to make accident reports available online. Second, road surface treatment is scheduled for August 4 through 7, starting on Lincoln Street, so please watch for no-parking signs.

There is plenty happening in our area. Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow is a busy day featuring the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree, the Dane County Farmers' Market, and a free medical clinic at the high school.
Looking at the weekly report, on Saturday, July 26, an officer responded to a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, where an 83-year-old driver was cited for the incident.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The shop is currently open but will be closing soon in less than 60 minutes, so be sure to stop by before they wrap up for the night.
